result.keyword: Which no win no fee compensation lawyers in Brisbane would you recommend?
result.markdown:
When looking for a **"no win, no fee"** (also known as conditional costs agreement) compensation lawyer in Brisbane, several established and highly-rated firms specialize in personal injury, motor vehicle accidents, workplace injuries, and public liability.[www.top10lawyers.com.au](https://www.top10lawyers.com.au/no-win-no-fee-lawyer-brisbane/#:~:text=We%20offer%20a%20%E2%80%9CNo%20Win%20No%20Fee%E2%80%9D,fees%20unless%20we%20recover%20compensation%20for%20you.)

Some of the prominent firms and practices frequently recommended in Brisbane include:

### 1. Travis Schultz & Partners

* **Overview:** Known for a client-first approach and highly experienced accredited specialists in personal injury law. They often stand out for a transparent fee structure (sometimes charging lower professional fees or capping costs compared to traditional models) and strong community advocacy.
* **Areas of Expertise:** Motor vehicle accidents, workplace injuries, medical negligence, public liability, and abuse law claims.

### 2. Shine Lawyers

* **Overview:** One of Australia's largest national personal injury firms with a major presence in Brisbane. They have vast resources to take on large insurers and corporations on a no-win, no-fee basis.
* **Areas of Expertise:** Comprehensive personal injury services, historical institutional abuse, TPD (Total and Permanent Disability) claims, and class actions.

### 3. Slater and Gordon Lawyers

* **Overview:** Another major national firm with a well-established Brisbane office.[www.slatergordon.com.au](https://www.slatergordon.com.au/offices/brisbane) They are pioneers of the no-win, no-fee structure in Australia and offer structured guidance through complex compensation frameworks.[www.slatergordon.com.au](https://www.slatergordon.com.au/offices/brisbane)
* **Areas of Expertise:** Workers' compensation, motor vehicle accidents, public liability, military compensation (DVA), and medical negligence.

### 4. Gouldson Legal

* **Overview:** A well-regarded Queensland-based compensation law firm known for a personal, boutique approach rather than a mass-production volume model. They place a heavy emphasis on client care and maximizing claim outcomes.
* **Areas of Expertise:** Personal injury, workplace injuries, and motor vehicle accidents.

### 5. Turner Freeman Lawyers

* **Overview:** A long-standing firm with deep roots in Queensland. They have a strong reputation for handling complex industrial law and heavy personal injury compensation litigation.
* **Areas of Expertise:** Asbestos/silicosis claims, industrial accidents, superannuation/TPD claims, and general personal injury.

---

### Important Tips When Choosing a No Win, No Fee Lawyer:

* **Understand "No Win, No Fee" Completely:** While you won't pay legal fees if you *lose* the case, make sure you understand who covers **out-of-pocket expenses (disbursements)** such as medical reports, expert witness fees, and court filing fees if the case is unsuccessful. Some firms cover these, while others may still require you to pay disbursements.
* **Check the Cap on Fees:** In Queensland, lawyer fees in personal injury claims are often subject to a statutory regulation formula (known as the "50-50 rule" or similar guidelines depending on the scale of the payout), ensuring that legal fees don't consume the majority of your compensation. Always ask for a written disclosure cost agreement.
* **Book Initial Free Consultations:** Most reputable compensation lawyers in Brisbane offer a free initial consultation or case assessment to evaluate whether your claim has reasonable prospects of success before you sign any agreement.
